This is only a plausible metric mechanism; no controlled experiment establishes why the owner-reported score changed.

hypotheses.rank_1: Age-matched Pleistocene Lake Lahontan shoreline displacement using 3DEP 1 m DEM + NGMDB age/level geometry; high cost; raw DEM and dated geometry absent; AOI coverage not currently verified.
hypotheses.rank_2: Time-ordered ComCat earthquake-sequence migration along blind fault planes; very high cost; no local time series; event completeness and AOI coverage not currently verified.
hypotheses.rank_3: Age-tagged geologic-unit contact termination/offset graph; high cost; no attributed polygons or verified product coverage locally.
